steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Exam Tip: Some Christians are concerned that Christmas has become too commercialised — the focus on presents and Santa Claus can overshadow the birth of Jesus. Churches work to keep the religious meaning central through nativity services, carol concerts and Advent reflections. | RS Exam Tips — Christmas and Easter: 1. For Christmas and Easter questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Christmas and Easter to its real-world impact on believers and society

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain why Easter is the most important Christian festival. | Explain two ways Christians celebrate Christmas.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on Exam Tip, RS Exam Tips — Christmas and Easter, and one past-paper question.
